summary.text: Sergio Farias is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 74 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Laurie Davies.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a former mayor and three-term city councilmember.

paragraphs.text: Sergio Farias said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he has worked full time since age 16, was a mayor and three-term city councilmember, and is serving his third council term while working as chief operating officer of a commercial landscaping business.
His campaign website likewise describes him as a former mayor and councilmember.
Farias advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
In the survey, he named funding for public education and affordability among his key messages.

sources.title: Sergio Farias — Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
